speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcript: This is the Angel Next Door Podcast, where we will talk about all things angel investing. What it is? Who does it? How do we find them? What does it mean to invest in an early stage company? If you have ever wondered how you can affect the change you want to see in the world, then tune in to learn more. Hi, everyone. In today's episode, I'm talking to Congressman David Kustoff. He's currently in his fourth term in the US House of Representatives, serving the 8th District of Tennessee. He serves on the House Committee on Ways and Means, which is the oldest committee in the US Congress, and has jurisdiction over issues such as taxes, healthcare, trade, and family support programs. In addition to serving on the full committee on Ways and Means, David was also appointed to serve on the Subcommittee on Tax, Trade, and Social Security. We talk a lot in this episode about section 1202 of the Internal Revenue Tax Code, also known as the Qualified Small Business Stock QSBS provision. Under 1202, capital gains from the sale of certain small business stocks are excluded from federal tax if they meet certain eligibility requirements. Why is this important? Well, it means that under some circumstances, angels, if they hold stock for a certain period of time, do not have to pay capital gains tax on the gains when the company exits. Many times angels don't realize that these incentives exist because there needs to be an exit before it becomes clear how it all works. In this episode, Congressman Kustoff talks about the bill that he introduced last month The Small Business Investment Act of 2023 that if signed into law will expand Section 1202 QSBS eligibility to more businesses make it easier and cheaper for businesses to raise capital and give businesses more flexibility in their financing options. The ACA CEO, Pat Goin, and our public policy team have met with the congressman's office before to discuss the importance of the expansion of Section 1202 QSBS. And we are excited that the bill has a companion in the Senate sponsored by Senator Cornyn of Texas. So there's lots in this episode about taxes and things like that. But at the end of the day, these are all super important because what it means is that we will be able to help get more funding to entrepreneurs so that they can go be the change that we want to see in the world. Thanks for listening. Enjoy the show. So as you know, the Angel Next Door podcast is all about how and why people become angels, as well as giving relevant and up-to-date information about helping angels make better decisions. So I'm excited today to talk to you about the Small Business Investment Act of 2023. But before we get to that, how about if you just start by telling us about your personal journey to Congress and what prompted you to run?
